rows.note: Use this for the creation and arrangement of dance movements, especially in a ballet or stage production.

example.english: The choreography of this ballet is very layered.
example.traditional: 呢齣芭蕾舞嘅編舞好有層次。
example.jyutping: ne1 ceot1 baa1 leoi4 mou5 ge3 pin1 mou5 hou2 jau5 cang4 ci3

rows.note: For the figurative sense, this is the all-purpose choice for planning and sequencing a coordinated operation or event.

example.english: The choreography of the whole wedding was left to her to handle.
example.traditional: 成個婚禮流程嘅安排都交畀佢跟。
example.jyutping: sing4 go3 fan1 lai5 lau4 cing4 ge3 on1 paai4 dou1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 gan1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on getting several people, teams, or work areas to function together.

example.english: The choreography behind getting several teams to work together isn’t easy.
example.traditional: 幾隊人一齊做嘢，背後嘅協調真係唔容易。
example.jyutping: gei2 deoi6 jan4 jat1 cai4 zou6 je5 bui3 hau6 ge3 hip3 tiu4 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6
